userscripts.instances: Column heading, and detail label, for how many pages were folded into this one script.
userscripts.intro: Introductory sentence explaining what the user-script directory lists and how it is ordered.
userscripts.introAll: Introductory sentence for the directory when no wiki is selected, explaining that the ranking spans every wiki the census covers.
userscripts.memberPage: Column heading for a page that was folded into this script.
userscripts.memberRelation: Column heading for the reason a page was folded into this script.
userscripts.membersCaption: Accessible caption of the table listing pages folded into one script.
userscripts.neverSwept: Warning shown when no full census of this wiki has ever finished, so the counts are incomplete.
userscripts.noMembers: Shown when no other page was folded into this script.
userscripts.noneForOwner: Shown when the owner filter matches no script in this tier. $1 is the owner's name.
userscripts.noneInTier: Shown when a tier of this wiki's directory holds no scripts.
userscripts.notEnumerated: Warning shown when the wiki has more user-space script pages than one search pass can list, so the census read only part of it.
userscripts.noWikis: Shown when no wiki has been swept for user scripts at all.
userscripts.oldestComputedAt: Label for the oldest of the per-wiki directory rebuild times, shown when the directory spans every wiki. The oldest is used because an average of many timestamps would describe no wiki.
userscripts.oldestCurrentTo: Label for the oldest point any covered wiki has been read up to, shown when the directory spans every wiki. Stated as a floor: every wiki is at least this current.
userscripts.owner: Column heading, and detail label, for the user whose user space holds the script.
userscripts.ownerLabel: Label for the control that narrows the directory to one script owner.
userscripts.ownerPlaceholder: Placeholder shown in the owner filter when no owner is selected.
userscripts.pagesSeen: Label for the number of user-space script pages the census has seen on this wiki.
userscripts.rank: Column heading for a script's position in the ranking.
userscripts.readOnWiki: Link from a script's entry to its source page on the wiki.
userscripts.relationCopy: Reason a page was folded in: its content is identical to the original.
userscripts.relationVariant: Reason a page was folded in: it shares the original's name but its content differs.
userscripts.retry: Label of the button that retries a failed directory request.
userscripts.script: Column heading for the script's name.
userscripts.showing: Summary above the directory table. $1 is the number of rows shown, $2 the number matching the filters.
userscripts.someNeverSwept:
Warning shown above a cross-wiki directory when some wikis have not finished a full sweep, so their script counts are a lower bound.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of such wikis, already formatted
userscripts.someNotEnumerated:
Warning shown above a cross-wiki directory when some wikis hold more user-space script pages than one search pass can list, so only part of their user space has been read.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of such wikis, already formatted
userscripts.sweptAt: Label for the time this wiki's user space was last enumerated and walked in full.
userscripts.tableCaption: Accessible caption of the directory table.
userscripts.tableCaptionAll: Accessible caption for the directory table when it ranks scripts from every wiki together rather than from one wiki.
userscripts.tierActive: Label of the tier holding scripts somebody loads. $1 is the number of scripts in it.
userscripts.tierArchive: Label of the tier holding scripts nobody loads. $1 is the number of scripts in it.
userscripts.tierNav: Accessible name of the navigation that switches between directory tiers.
userscripts.unknownScript: Shown when the requested page is not in this wiki's directory at all.
userscripts.wikiLabel: Label for the control that chooses which wiki's directory to show.
userscripts.wikisCovered: Label for how many of the wikis in the census have at least one script filed in the directory.
userscripts.wikisOf:
Value pairing a count with the total it is drawn from, as in "412 of 1,022".

Parameters:
* $1 - the count, already formatted
* $2 - the total, already formatted

whatsNew.close: Message shown in the whats new interface for close.
whatsNew.closeButton: Message shown in the whats new interface for close button.
whatsNew.forUsers: Message shown in the whats new interface for for users.
whatsNew.fullChangelog: Message shown in the whats new interface for full changelog.
whatsNew.intro: Message shown in the whats new interface for intro.
whatsNew.neverButton: Message shown in the whats new interface for never button.
whatsNew.noReleases: Message shown in the whats new interface for no releases.
whatsNew.release: Message shown in the whats new interface for release.

Message shown in the whats new interface for released.

whatsNew.releaseFallback: Message shown in the whats new interface for release fallback.
whatsNew.technicalDetails: Message shown in the whats new interface for technical details.
whatsNew.title: Message shown in the whats new interface for title.
whatsNew.unknownDate: Message shown in the whats new interface for unknown date.
worker.backToAll: Link back to the list of all background workers. The arrow is decorative.
worker.colStarted: Table column heading for the time one job run started.
worker.docTitle: Document title for one worker's page. $1 is the worker's name.
worker.errorBody: Error body shown when one worker's run history cannot be loaded.
worker.errorTitle: Error heading shown when one worker's run history cannot be loaded.
worker.lastSuccess: Label for the timestamp of the most recent successful run.
worker.loading: Loading message shown while one worker's run history is fetched.
worker.retained: Label for how many past runs are shown out of how many are kept.
worker.runsTitle: Heading for the table of past runs and the work each one reported.
worker.silentRuns: Note under the runs table. $1 is the number of runs that recorded no figures.
worker.trendChange: Change in a coverage figure. $1 is a plus or minus sign, $2 the amount, $3 the number of runs.
worker.trendFlat: Shown when a coverage figure has not moved. $1 is the number of runs.
worker.trendLead: Explanation under the progression heading on one worker's page.
worker.trendTitle: Heading for the section showing how a worker's coverage has moved over time.
workers.allHealthy: Shown when every background worker is running on schedule.
workers.attention: Alert summary. $1 is the number of workers that are stalled or failing.
workers.daysAgo: Elapsed time. $1 is a number of days.
workers.definitionRecorded: Heading for the glossary entry explaining which background job executions are recorded as runs.
workers.docTitle: Document title for the background workers page.
workers.errorBody: Error body shown when worker status cannot be loaded.
workers.errorTitle: Error heading shown when worker status cannot be loaded.
workers.everyDays: Schedule description. $1 is a number of days.
workers.everyHours: Schedule description. $1 is a number of hours.
workers.everyMinute: Schedule description for a worker that runs once a minute.
workers.everyMinutes: Schedule description. $1 is a number of minutes.
workers.exitCode: Failure detail. $1 is the process exit code.
workers.eyebrow: Eyebrow label marking the page as Evolved-local data.
workers.hoursAgo: Elapsed time. $1 is a number of hours.
workers.justNow: Shown when a worker ran less than a minute ago.
workers.lastDuration: Label for how long the worker's last run took.
workers.lastRun: Label for how long ago the worker last ran.
workers.lead: Introduction explaining what the background workers page lists.
workers.loading: Loading message shown while worker status is fetched.
workers.methodTitle: Summary label for the explanation of how worker states are decided.
workers.minutes: Short duration. $1 is a number of minutes.
workers.minutesAgo: Elapsed time. $1 is a number of minutes.
workers.never: Shown when a worker has never run.
workers.noRuns: Shown in place of the run history when nothing has been recorded.
workers.outcome: Label for the result of the worker's last run.
workers.periodUnknown: Schedule description for a worker whose period cannot be derived.
workers.recentRuns: Accessible label for the list of recent runs.
workers.retry: Button that retries loading the worker status.
workers.runFailed: Result label for a run that failed.
workers.runOk: Result label for a run that finished successfully.
workers.runsCaption: Caption above the run-history ticks on a background worker card. $1 is the number of run slots shown (a number).
workers.seconds: Short duration. $1 is a number of seconds.
workers.showFull: Label for the button that expands a background worker's truncated description. Used on Special:Workers cards.
workers.showLess: Label for the button that re-collapses a background worker's expanded description.
workers.statusFailing: Status label: the worker's most recent run exited with an error.
workers.statusHealthy: Status label: the worker is running as scheduled.
workers.statusLate: Status label: the worker has not run for several of its scheduled periods.
workers.statusStalled: Status label: the worker has not run for many periods, so its schedule is not honoured.
workers.statusUnknown: Status label: no run has been recorded for this worker yet.
workers.title: Heading of the background workers status page.
